name: Rock County, WI
findings: Rock County has 473 nonprofit organizations. 208 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 172 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rock County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 9 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
